proof_methods: Petersen three-edge-colorability obstruction and incidence parity
Explicit witness colorings in all 16 occupancy sectors
Two complete and independently implemented exact ternary enumerations

scientific_limitations: The claim concerns an explicitly fixed finite 15-site line graph, at zero temperature, with homogeneous antiferromagnetic coupling and a uniform one-color field.
No thermodynamic-limit transition, finite-temperature kinetics, disordered-coupling extension, or uniqueness of publication priority is asserted.
title: A snark-induced zero-field occupancy jump in the three-state Petersen-line Potts antiferromagnet
